name: cloudmind
description: XMind-style mind maps for Obsidian, stored as plain Markdown.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:ui: esbuild test/harness.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=test/harness.js --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-stub.ts --main-fields=module,main --log-level=error && node test/make-html.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/idle.mjs && node test/ui.mjs && node test/wiki.mjs && node test/wheel.mjs && node test/theme.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:md && npm run test:ui
